name: @apelles/beats
description: Apelles beat-grid maths (D-413): the beat-analysis types `chroma_detect_beats` answers with, nearest-beat snapping, and the cue grammar that maps named moves to beats ("downbeat 1", "next strong beat", "every beat between"). Pure TypeScript: no Tauri, no React, no store; both the Edit and the Motion tab depend on it.
